title: KLEIN LAYERS — Four layers, one surface, content flows without DNS
kevins_insight: Porkbun is JUST the domain line — .[primals].(eco). The content already flows through GitHub, RSS, Tor, and raw IP. We don't NEED DNS to be visible. DNS is the LABEL, not the PIPE.
